title: Photorealistic live-action Japanese movi
prompt:
Photorealistic live-action Japanese movie frame featuring a completely fictional adult Japanese woman, age 22.

A professionally staged safe wire-action scene creating an exaggerated anime-style mid-air moment against a real daytime sky.

CAMERA / COMPOSITION:
Extreme low-angle 18mm ultra-wide camera directly underneath her.
Her body crosses the frame diagonally.

One worn sneaker sole is extremely close to the lens and dominates the foreground through strong natural perspective distortion.
Her other leg extends diagonally away.
Her torso and face rapidly become smaller with distance.
Arms spread naturally in an asymmetrical mid-motion pose.

OUTFIT / MOTION:
Loose ordinary white T-shirt.
Dark pleated skirt.
Clearly visible fitted black athletic shorts underneath as part of the outfit.
Sneakers.

Strong airflow creates irregular physical movement:
the T-shirt balloons and wrinkles unevenly,
the skirt reacts naturally to airflow,
hair separates into messy strands with several flyaway hairs crossing her face.

REAL CAMERA IMPERFECTIONS:
Natural Japanese skin texture, visible pores, tiny blemishes and subtle uneven skin tone.
Slight facial asymmetry.
No porcelain skin.

Foreground sneaker sharper than the distant face.
Slight motion blur on hair tips, hands and fluttering fabric.
Real fabric seams, wrinkles and tension.
Subtle 18mm edge distortion.
Minor chromatic aberration.
Fine sensor noise.
Slight atmospheric haze.
Restrained natural colors.
Slightly imperfect real-camera white balance.

Ordinary real photographed blue sky with irregular clouds.
Slightly washed-out blue near the sun.
No fantasy-perfect clouds.

The image should feel like one accidentally perfect frame captured during a practical Japanese live-action movie stunt — physical, spontaneous and imperfect rather than CGI.

NO:
beauty retouching, airbrushed skin, perfect symmetry, excessive sharpness, HDR, artificial lens flare, fake sun rays, oversaturated sky, cinematic teal-orange grading, perfectly arranged hair, CGI appearance, text, logo.

Vertical 9:16.
